column1: # The syntax layer's messages: every ID the pinned qkparser module ships.
#   id     dotted <domain>.<snake_case>, stable forever, never renumbered, never recycled
#   owner  "import" when the pinned qkparser module owns the ID, "local" when this repository does
#   ctx    where the message is raised, for the translator
#   note   what it means, for the translator
#   src    the text the pinned module ships for this ID; generation fails when it drifts
# The row order is the module's row order, and it is load bearing: a message's Msg constant is its
# position here, and internal/lang converts a qkparser.ID - also a position - to it. Appending to the
# module's table appends here, in the same order.
# A row whose zh value equals its en value is not translated yet. Those are the messages that shipped
# English-only before step 3 of docs/i18n-design.md, when they had no ID and no catalog entry at all:
# they rendered English under QK_LANG=zh and nothing counted them. The migration may not invent a
# translation, because the rendering has to stay byte-identical across it, so the column repeats the
# source and the gap is now visible in the table instead of invisible in the code.
